## Public material-gap classification

- `MG-O1`: `PLANNER_OWNED_IMPLEMENTATION_GAP`. Current execution accepts caller-supplied UnitBudget values; target execution derives a complete budget from the selected contract and rejects incomplete or insufficient reservation before effects.

Each row is authenticated by its current-source evidence item and remains separate from the approved target proposal.
